name: Rage Longinus
description: Fury incarnate, elevated to Epic tier. Rage Longinus is a berserker that feeds on punishment — the more damage it absorbs, the more unstoppable it becomes. Push it to its limit and face the full wrath of the Rage Engine.

ability.name: Rage Engine
ability.description: Every time Rage Longinus takes damage it gains +10 ATK, stacking up to 6 times for a maximum of +60 ATK. At 5 stacks it enters BERSERKER STATE: +20 bonus damage on every attack and -20 incoming damage, for the rest of the battle. At 6 stacks (max rage) Inferno Crush gains a 5th hit — +30 damage, taking the Special from 4×30 (120) to 5×30 (150).

special_move.name: Inferno Crush
special_move.description: A rage-fueled, stadium-splitting barrage — four overhead slams at 30 damage each for 120 total. At 6 Rage stacks a 5th slam is added: +30 damage, 150 total.
flavour_texts: 🔥 **Crush 2** — The stadium floor cracks under the pressure!
